title: Key Jets rookie to miss time after “setback”

sources.title: Key Jets rookie to miss time after “setback”
sources.description: Jets rookie tight end Kenyon Sadiq is going to miss time in training camp per head coach Aaron Glenn. It’s a positive that Sadiq is likely to be ready by Week 1, but the Jets are surely hoping he won’t be out for long. Training camp reps are arguably more important to Sadiq than any […]
